content.title: 巨构近触｜尺度远景与微动作回望
content.summary: 巨型场景先把旅行者缩小，再靠近一个可读微动作，最后回原远景。

quick_start.input_format: 巨构＋旅行者＋近接微动作＋原位远景
quick_start.recommended_input: 一名成年文物修复师、一座巨大的青铜水钟大厅、从开头已亮的少量校准灯和一个待检查的固定齿轮盒。
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 巨型场景先把旅行者缩小，再靠近一个可读微动作，最后回原远景。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: A monumental environment makes one traveler tiny; grounded movement inserts tighten to a near-contact micro-gesture, then a return to the unchanged wide site lets intimate attention alter the viewer's reading of scale.

invariants.rule: A monumental site and much smaller moving subject share one opening geography.
invariants.purpose: Sets a visible travel objective and scale contrast.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the original size contrast the late wide return has no recontextualization.

invariants.rule: Interrupt approach with physically grounded micro inserts before a held intimate gesture.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the grounded detail, the close-up feels like an unrelated portrait.

invariants.rule: Return to the original large geography after the small gesture without claiming an unobserved environment switch.
invariants.purpose: Makes the held detail resonate at larger scale.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the return, the macro/micro relationship remains unclosed.

slots.name: traveler
slots.constraint: One stable human, animal or machine with grounded locomotion.

slots.name: monumental_site
slots.constraint: One pre-established large environment with persistent geography.

slots.name: contact_detail
slots.constraint: Small readable surface or mechanism the traveler can approach.

slots.name: micro_gesture
slots.constraint: Held minimal movement with a visible physical relation.

slots.name: light_system
slots.constraint: Already established practical or environmental lights; no required magic activation.

anti_copy_exclusions: Do not use the source white deer, ancient glowing tree or forest-light pattern.
No invented light ignition on contact: source tree is lit before approach.
No source handle, watermark, exact bark-contact pose or copied animal portrait.

instantiations.concept: An adult instrument conservator enters an immense dark water-clock hall where scattered bronze calibration lamps already glow. A wide view makes her small beneath the mechanism. Close shots show boot soles crossing grates and a gloved thumb inspecting one tiny engraved gear; she holds her breath and rests a fingertip on the stopped tooth. The camera returns wide to the same already glowing water clock, with the conservator tiny at its base; no magical activation is implied.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Adult conservator, giant water clock, boot grate, gloved gear touch, unchanged wide hall.

instantiations.concept: A small autonomous reef-inspection rover travels across the deck of a vast grounded oceanographic vessel at dawn. Begin with the entire hull and tiny machine, cut to tread contact and a sensor lens rotating toward a worn hull seam, hold the lens close without activating any new lights, then return to the same wide ship to make the inspected point feel consequential.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Autonomous reef rover, drydocked ship hull, tread and sensor inserts, unchanged wide vessel.

failure_modes.failure: No visible site scale before inserts.
failure_modes.repair: Open wide enough to read the traveler as small against the whole structure.
Keep direction and material consistent across the approach.

failure_modes.failure: A sudden activation is treated as source evidence.
failure_modes.repair: Keep site lighting established from the opening; target may use independent causally shown activation only if separately authored.

transfer_tests.concept: An adult instrument conservator enters an immense dark water-clock hall where scattered bronze calibration lamps already glow. A wide view makes her small beneath the mechanism. Close shots show boot soles crossing grates and a gloved thumb inspecting one tiny engraved gear; she holds her breath and rests a fingertip on the stopped tooth. The camera returns wide to the same already glowing water clock, with the conservator tiny at its base; no magical activation is implied.

A small autonomous reef-inspection rover travels across the deck of a vast grounded oceanographic vessel at dawn. Begin with the entire hull and tiny machine, cut to tread contact and a sensor lens rotating toward a worn hull seam, hold the lens close without activating any new lights, then return to the same wide ship to make the inspected point feel consequential.
